I've personally observed four recent meetings in which the same senior colleague repeatedly interrupted newer team members before they could finish. I haven't raised this with Helena before now because I don't want to be seen as accusing that colleague of bad intent. My requested safeguard is a facilitator-enforced no-interruption rule in the charter.
